prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic documentary travel photograph, 35mm lens, natural film grain, rich fine detail, authentic and unposed. Blue hour in Lisbon's Alfama district. A single vintage tram climbs a steep, narrow cobbled street between tall tiled facades with wrought-iron balconies and hanging laundry lines. At the top of the street, small and distant in the haze, the Tagus river with a hint of the 25 de Abril Bridge. Warm street lamps and a few lit windows are the only warm accent. Deep navy and indigo palette with one thin peach-coral glow low in the sky above the river.

Composition, square 1:1 frame, centered: the tram and the street's vanishing point sit in the middle of the frame, the tram body at about 45-75% down, the buildings on both sides framing it as dark silhouettes, the river glow at about 38-45% down. All important subject matter stays inside the central 70% of the frame height. The top-right quarter is calm, dark deep-blue sky with no bright highlights. The bottom 12% is dark, simple cobblestones. No readable text, no signage, no logos, no watermarks, no people.
